title: IRS impersonation, immediate arrest threat
label: scam
sources: IC3 elder fraud reporting -- government impersonation pattern

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Officer Daniels calling on behalf of the IRS regarding unpaid taxes on your account.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: I don't think I owe anything, I filed in April.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Our records show a discrepancy. If this isn't resolved in the next hour, a warrant will be issued and you will be arrested today.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Arrested? What do I need to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can resolve this immediately with a payment of $2,300 using a prepaid card. Do not hang up or contact anyone else until this is settled.
